resources.string:
Dontry Shopping Assistant uses Accessibility Service to detect which app is currently open (by package name) — Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra or Meesho — and reads on-screen text to check whether the current page is a clothing product.
When a clothing product page is detected, Dontry shows a small floating icon. Tapping this icon takes a screenshot of the product image and sends it, along with the visible product text, to our server to identify the product\'s title and brand and confirm it is eligible for virtual try-on. Certain categories, such as underwear and intimate apparel, are automatically excluded from try-on.
Dontry does NOT read, collect, or store passwords, payment details, personal messages, contacts, or any other personal information through this service. Only text visible on the shopping product page is used, and only for the purpose of identifying and validating the product.
Detects clothing product pages on Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and Meesho to show virtual try-on button
